theorems.name: Submission.ae_hausdorffMeasure_fiber_eq_zero_of_small_ball_covers
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (ν : Measure Y) (k : ℕ) (K : Set X) (G : X → Y), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ (s : Finset X) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 2 * r ≤ δ ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ s, closedBall x r ∧ ∑ x ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * r) ^ k) * ν (G '' closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) → ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, μH[k] (K ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}) = 0
